import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 12345678;
    static int n, t;
    static char[][] grid, grid1;
    static int[][] d, d1;
    static List<Integer>[] v;
    static Cap[][] caps;
    static int[] left, right, col;
    static Queue<Node> q;
    static class Node {
        int i, j, no;
        Node(int i, int j, int no) {
            this.i = i; this.j = j; this.no = no;
        }
    }
    static class Cap {
        int[] no = new int[1001];
        int ind;
        int fl;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        grid = new char[n][n];
        grid1 = new char[n][n];
        d = new int[n][n];
        d1 = new int[n][n];
        v = new ArrayList[1000];
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        caps = new Cap[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid1[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                d[i][j] = INF;
                d1[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                caps[i][j] = new Cap();

        q = new LinkedList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    bfs(new Node(i, j, 0));
                }
            }
        }

        int mark = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid1[i][j])) {
                    int k = grid1[i][j] - '0';
                    if (k > 0) caps[i][j].fl = 1;
                    caps[i][j].ind = k;
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                        caps[i][j].no[l] = mark++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int totalMarks = mark - 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid[i][j])) {
                    int k = grid[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                        Node temp = new Node(i, j, 0);
                        temp.no = mark++;
                        bfst(temp);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(match(totalMarks));
    }

    static boolean dfs(int s) {
        if (col[s] == 1) return false;
        col[s] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < v[s].size(); i++) {
            int k = v[s].get(i);
            if (left[k] == -1) {
                left[k] = s;
                right[s] = i;
                return true;
            } else if (dfs(left[k])) {
                left[k] = s;
                right[s] = i;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int match(int n) {
        Arrays.fill(left, -1);
        Arrays.fill(right, -1);
        int res = 0;
        boolean done;
        do {
            done = true;
            Arrays.fill(col, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                if (right[i] == -1 && dfs(i)) {
                    done = false;
                }
            }
        } while (!done);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            if (right[i] != -1) res++;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void bfst(Node s) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                d1[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        d1[s.i][s.j] = 0;
        q.clear();
        q.offer(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Node temp = q.poll();
            int i = temp.i;
            int j = temp.j;

            if (grid[i][j] == 'Y') continue;

            if (caps[i][j].fl == 1) {
                if (d1[i][j] <= t && d1[i][j] <= d[i][j]) {
                    for (int k = 1; k <= caps[i][j].ind; k++) {
                        v[s.no].add(caps[i][j].no[k]);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (d1[i][j] >= d[i][j]) continue;

            int[][] directions = { {1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1} };
            for (int[] dir : directions) {
                int ni = i + dir[0];
                int nj = j + dir[1];
                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n) {
                    if (d1[ni][nj] > d1[i][j] + 1) {
                        d1[ni][nj] = d1[i][j] + 1;
                        q.offer(new Node(ni, nj, 0));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs(Node s) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                d[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        d[s.i][s.j] = 0;
        q.clear();
        q.offer(s);

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Node temp = q.poll();
            int i = temp.i;
            int j = temp.j;

            if (grid[i][j] == 'Y') continue;

            int[][] directions = { {1, 0}, {-1, 0}, {0, 1}, {0, -1} };
            for (int[] dir : directions) {
                int ni = i + dir[0];
                int nj = j + dir[1];
                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n) {
                    if (d[ni][nj] > d[i][j] + 1) {
                        d[ni][nj] = d[i][j] + 1;
                        q.offer(new Node(ni, nj, 0));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
